verdict.score_rationale: The board is readable with effort at the 6–6.5 anchor: its four regions and core flows are recoverable, but small type, crowded inter-region routing, and several long blue and gray detours prevent fluent arm's-length reading.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most boxes and chips have clear local spacing, but many labels and node captions are very small, while the publication/retrieval boundary concentrates several routes and chips into a tight horizontal band.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: The four numbered, framed regions make ingestion, publication, retrieval, and rebuilding easy to distinguish, though publication and retrieval are visually entangled by multiple cross-region blue routes.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Arrowheads, colors, and labels usually communicate direction, but long blue perimeter-like runs, closely parallel vertical routes near the stores, and extended gray inter-region paths require careful tracing.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Branches for changed versus unchanged content, retry/dead-letter handling, parallel retrieval, version validation, and rollback are visibly decomposed, but the large canvas and fine text make the overall topology harder to absorb at a glance.
